payload.artist_html: Rafael Terras, Jaqueline Borger, Manuelle O. P. Almeida, Silvia Bettin, Owen A. Higgins, Giulia Marciani, Stefano Benazzi, Rodrigo T. Müller, Leonardo Kerber and Mirian Carbonera
payload.description_html: Isolated Triassic archosaur teeth and their histological thin sections. A, functional Macrocollum tooth (CAPPA/UFSM 0001d). B, functional Gnathovorax tooth (CAPPA/UFSM 0009). C, shed Dynamosuchus tooth (CAPPA/UFSM 0248). D, shed Archosauria indet. tooth (CAPPA/UFSM 0505). E, shed cf. Gnathovorax cabreirai tooth (CAPPA/UFSM 0403). A, B, E, in cross-polarized reflected light; C, in reflected light; D, in cross-polarized transmitted light. All scale bars represent 10 mm.
